title: ophrys lutea var. minor
intro: Ophrys lutea var. minor, commonly known as the Yellow Bee Orchid, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Orchidaceae family. It is known for its unique, yellow-colored flowers that mimic the color and shape of bees to attract pollinators. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys lutea var. minor include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and support the immune system, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids.
